metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Customer metadata. An empty object is created when omitted or null.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Customer identity identifiers. At least one is required.

payload.title: CreateCustomerRequest
payload.description:
Plain customer creation request, not get-or-create.

At least one identifier is required; customers without identifiers are not
allowed. A customer cannot be created from profile fields alone.

name.title: Name
name.description: Customer name. Omit to keep the current value.

note.title: Note
note.description: Customer note. Omit to keep the current value.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Customer metadata. Provided keys are added or updated with a shallow merge, and omitted keys are retained. Key deletion is not supported.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Identity identifiers to add to this customer. Omit to leave identifiers unchanged.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Customer attribute values to update. Only provided names are changed; null deletes that name even if its definition is inactive or deleted. Setting a non-null value requires an active attribute definition.

payload.title: PatchCustomerRequest
payload.description:
Customer update request with at least one field to change.

Omitted fields are retained. `metadata` is shallow-merged by adding new keys
and updating existing keys; key deletion is not supported. Provided
`identifiers` are added to the customer and are not modified or removed in place.

value.title: Value
value.description: Identifier value. Phone numbers are normalized to canonical KR national format without hyphens, emails are validated and lowercased, and leading and trailing whitespace is removed from external IDs.

CustomerIdentifierInput.title: CustomerIdentifierInput
CustomerIdentifierInput.description:
One customer identity identifier input shared by create, patch, and find.

`type` accepts only `phone`, `email`, or `external_id`; other values return
400. The service layer normalizes `value` according to its type.
